name: Watching copy (VAR(3) from rest), group 1
description: A linear model fitted to the atlas worms' stimulation-free activity (what watching teaches), simulated on held-out worm templates.

rest_dim.label: few patterns at rest
rest_dim.about: Share of resting variance in the 3 strongest patterns: how few patterns the activity uses.

slow_share.label: slow activity
slow_share.about: Share of each unit's activity that is slow (still correlated 10 to 40 s later).

correlation.label: units move together
correlation.about: Mean absolute correlation between units at rest.

timescale.label: timescale
timescale.about: Median time for a unit's activity to become half-forgotten (autocorrelation 0.5), in seconds.

echo_breadth.label: push spread
echo_breadth.about: Share of units that a single push moves by more than 1 SD, minus the same share at moments with no push.

evoked_share.label: push stands out
evoked_share.about: How much of the change after a push is caused by the push, against moments with no push.

tiring.label: tiring on a second push
tiring.about: Log change in a unit's own response when it is pushed a second time, against matched controls. Negative = it answers less.

watch_share.label: copyable by watching
watch_share.about: How well a linear model fitted only to resting activity predicts the push responses, as a share of how well runs agree with each other. Real worms: poorly.

result.how: simulated on 30 held-out atlas worm templates, measured exactly as worms
